title: Amazon EventBridge to AWS Lambda
description: Create an EventBridge rule that invokes a Lambda function

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This project contains a sample AWS CDK template for invoking AWS Lambda from an Amazon EventBridge Rule. It also creates a CloudWatch Log Group for the Lambda function for observation of incoming events, with a retention and removal policy.
